name: atlas-workspaces
description: Atlas's TypeScript lanes (issue #5 §3.1): analysis/, the cell systems, and render/, the deletable rendering seam. The pre-rewrite frontend/ had a package and a lock file of its own, and left with the rest of that tree for the golden-reference tag.

scripts.lane: npm run --silent lint && tsc --project analysis/tsconfig.json && npm run --silent test && echo 'analysis lane: the boundary rules, tsc --strict and the conformance suite all green'
scripts.seam-lane: npm run --silent lint && tsc --project render/tsconfig.json && npm run --silent seam-test && node render/tools/lines.mjs && echo 'render lane: the boundary rules, tsc --strict, the seam tests and the line budget all green'
